source_2026.source_subsites: Cape Bird Middle/North/South; Cape Crozier East/West; Cape Royds

historic_publication.title: Lyver et al 2014 Trends in the Breeding Population of Adelie Penguins in the Ross Sea, 1981–2012
historic_publication.source: publication Table 1 2012 count column (parentheses); the published original data may be reproduced exactly in the 2026 compiled source

test.Ross Bird aggregation: sum 2012 counts for Bird North, Middle, South only; all three original source cells must be numeric
test.Ross Crozier aggregation: sum 2012 original source Crozier East + West; both real numeric cells required
test.Royds: direct 2012 original source Cape Royds numeric cell
test.match: exact count match to 2014 published original 2012 aggregates; do not claim all rows independent
test.scientific_scope: source pedigree/independence gate, not hypothesis test of iceberg recolonization or dispersal
test.negative_case: if any mismatch, hold; do not silently correct source records or invent authors' source data

prior_art_veto: Lyver 2014 already reported 2012 Ross Island counts
